purpose: Provide a deterministic 30,000-foot-to-rabbit-hole descent path for future agents without flattening evidence classes, raw-unioning graph families, or losing the highest-information negative results.

frontier_stack.question: Does the v0.11 localization advantage survive a classifier freeze, preregistration before evaluator implementation, label-blind adjudicator input, repeated mutation instances, and a preregistered uncertainty-separation criterion?
frontier_stack.result: Across 72 preregistered authored instances (six conditions x twelve deterministic recipe variants; 60 defect rows), terminal-only and role-typed paths both achieved 72/72 binary correctness. Terminal-only defect localization was 0/60 and role-typed localization was 60/60. Descriptive row-level Wilson 95% intervals separated (collapsed upper approximately 0.0602; role-typed lower approximately 0.9398). The primary demonstrated contribution is bounded diagnostic resolution rather than terminal decision gain. Recipe family, not row count, is the defensible independence unit; this remains authored repository evidence rather than external empirical validation.
frontier_stack.next_test: Use multiple structurally distinct mutation recipes per stage, unseen defect subtypes, and multi-defect collisions; score hierarchical stage localization separately from exact-subtype localization under leave-one-recipe-family-out evaluation, treating recipe family rather than row count as the primary independence unit.

frontier_stack.question: On defect families excluded from v0.10's three-world construction, does role-typed stage-local adjudication improve defect localization beyond a terminal-only classifier without changing binary accept/reject accuracy?
frontier_stack.result: Across five held-out defect families plus one valid control, terminal-only and role-typed paths both achieved 1.0 accept/reject accuracy. Defect localization separated: terminal-only 0.0 versus role-typed 1.0. The strengthened control replaced a mocked replay failure with an actual post-digest round-trip receipt tamper.
frontier_stack.next_test: Freeze the adjudicator, preregister the mutation schedule before evaluator implementation, blind expected labels from adjudicator input, repeat mutations, and estimate uncertainty.

frontier_stack.question: When Flow-Core context and an Aperture round-trip receipt meet inside Phase-5 relation construction, does preserving their separate typed boundaries add adjudication value beyond one collapsed handoff result?
frontier_stack.result: Three hostile worlds collapse to the same terminal HOLD while role-typed boundaries recover Flow-Core authority breach, cross-family reference mismatch, and Aperture jurisdiction breach. Reference consistency adds adjudication value without establishing truth.
frontier_stack.next_test: Compare terminal-only and role-typed adjudication on held-out defects while scoring binary disposition separately from defect localization.

frontier_stack.question: Does collapse-retention generalize to a second repository family, and must retained boundaries be typed by the value they actually contribute?
frontier_stack.result: Flow-Core generalized the collapse discipline but rejected a single operator crown: governance/type-safety, projection/data-minimization, diagnostic-localization, and integrity/formal-invariant roles were retained; zero scientific epistemic operators were promoted.
frontier_stack.next_test: Apply role-typed boundary scoring to a cross-family handoff.

frontier_stack.question: Which repository stage boundaries earn independent value under source-bound intervention, observability, localization, held-out consequence, or formal-invariant tests?
frontier_stack.result: A15-R0 scoring retained three of four bounded stage boundaries; the typed-deficit classifier-to-audit wrapper lost independent scientific-operator status while remaining useful receipt scaffolding.
frontier_stack.next_test: Repeat on a second independent repository family.

frontier_stack.question: Does a compact arrow-chain preserve enough relation semantics to justify distinct operators?
frontier_stack.result: Shared arrow glyph does not identify operator type; exact stage collapse can preserve terminal behavior while stage-local witnesses preserve diagnostic localization.
frontier_stack.next_test: Apply stage-collapse and stage-local witness scoring to source-bound repository episodes.

frontier_stack.question: Does retrieval-observability deficit monotonically increase semantic redundancy under reduced capacity?
frontier_stack.result: NO_UNIVERSAL_ARROW; ranking policy and diversity control can reverse the direction.
frontier_stack.next_test: Move from synthetic orthonormal corpus to source-bound retrieval episodes.

frontier_stack.question: Which foundational Eclipse-Omega claims survive ordinary nomenclature, type checking, hostile counterexamples, and provenance separation?
frontier_stack.result: Many universal claims were demoted or rejected; useful residue remains project taxonomy, local protocol, empirical hypothesis, or operator-fidelity target with zero novelty promotion.
frontier_stack.next_test: Primitive -> typed relation -> composition -> behavioral residue.

frontier_stack.question: Does the exact PRCS-A stage order identify a unique internal pipeline from terminal behavior?
frontier_stack.result: ORDER_EFFECT != ORDER_IDENTIFICATION; terminally equivalent permutations exist and an intermediate witness can separate them.

frontier_stack.question: Which broad TD613 novelty claims survive targeted conventional literature attack?
frontier_stack.result: Broad novelty/component-novelty claims were repeatedly killed; surviving targets are compositions, governance criteria, or application-specific audit machinery.
frontier_stack.next_test: Prefer measurable contribution and operator fidelity over coinage or analogy.

frontier_stack.question: Does the bounded Wendbine public packet give TD613 better names, better operators, or both?
frontier_stack.result: BOTH_NAME_HEAVY; ordinary terminology substantially improves TD613 while several local operator distinctions remain useful. EchoCore did not reconstruct cleanly.
frontier_stack.next_test: Keep donor terminology separate from construct provenance.

negative_results_to_notice_first: The v0.12 preregistered result preserves 1.0 binary accuracy for both paths while localization separates 0/60 terminal-only from 60/60 role-typed.
The twelve repetitions per condition are deterministic variations of six authored recipe families; row-level Wilson intervals are descriptive and do not authorize iid population-confidence claims.
Preregistration before evaluator implementation strengthens internal falsifiability but is not external validation.
A frozen classifier is not an independent external classifier.
Localization advantage is diagnostic value, not truth gain, externality proof, deployed-LLM inference, or scientific epistemic-operator promotion.
The v0.11 held-out matrix is authored and repository-local; held-out-from-v0.10 does not make it external empirical validation.
A generic cross-family HOLD does not identify whether Flow-Core authority, the Flow-Core-to-Aperture reference join, or Aperture round-trip jurisdiction failed.
Cross-family reference consistency adds adjudication value but does not establish truth, identity, causation, or external origin.
Multi-receipt provenance is not multi-source empirical confirmation.
Boundary retention does not imply scientific epistemic-operator promotion; retained value must be role-typed.
Two distinct Flow-Core snapshot histories can share the same PARTIAL aggregate status while per-snapshot entries preserve failure location, even when snapshot identity and ordering are held fixed.
Digest verification witnesses integrity of the admitted series object, not empirical truth or external origin.
A non-projected upstream receipt field cannot be treated as absent from the source merely because the downstream series omits it.
An audit receipt wrapper can remain operationally useful without earning independent epistemic-operator status.
A null widening selection does not uniquely identify invalid versus missing noise geometry.
Question selection under one declared criterion is not held-out validation or universal downstream optimality.
A shared arrow glyph identifies directed adjacency but does not identify operator type, causation, or common codomain.
Exact functional stage collapse can preserve terminal behavior; terminal equivalence does not establish stage identity.
EchoCore correction did not reconstruct cleanly from the remaining public topology.
Serial order has not been shown to add predictive power at day-level timestamp resolution.
PRCS-A terminal behavior does not uniquely identify its internal stage order.
Retrieval-observability deficit does not universally force semantic redundancy upward.
Zero registered events do not identify hidden internal interaction without an independent witness.
Monotone narrowing is not a universal law of ontology-conditioned RAG.

cross_atelier_rule.interchange: Compare through typed packets and explicit evidence classes; do not raw-union SRC, EMSTD613, and WENDBINE graphs.
cross_atelier_rule.future_agent_instruction: At 30K feet, open the findings index and compare frontier questions plus negative results first. Descend only through typed pointers when a cross-Atelier resonance survives the evidence-class check.
